methods.summary: The board describes how teams have played recently. It is not a forecast: the rolling-window study found that recent form adds nothing measurable beyond Elo. For every window, carry-over method and weighting tested, the 95% interval of the gain over Elo includes zero. The board does not predict results beyond what Elo already predicts.

windows.default_rule: the longest window in which at least 80% of teams are ranked
windows.note: 6 and 9 games are the windows the study supports (next-game win and next-game margin). 3 games is the short recent-games view and the noisiest; the study does not support it predictively.

carry_over.definition: Windows run across the season boundary. Each carried game's value is pulled toward the league average of its own season: value -> average + 0.50^(seasons back) x (value - average). Every team is ranked from week 1. carried_games counts last season's games in each team's window.

methods.form: Opponent-adjusted EPA per play, offense minus defense allowed: a game's offensive EPA/play minus the opponent's mean EPA/play allowed over its earlier games this season (its previous season before its first game), and likewise for defense. Regular season only; every play with an offense, a defense and EPA.

components.trend: form minus the season-to-date mean of form
components.residual: window mean of point margin minus the production Elo expected margin
components.elo_change: Elo change over the window (window mean of per-game Elo change x games)

combined_score.standardisation: Each component is z-scored across teams within the season-week (each team after its latest game that week); a component equal for every team is 0; at least 10 teams needed.
combined_score.formula: sum over components of weight x z
combined_score.weights_source: Best held-out weights under mean_regress, rolling-window study Table 10, commit 4ac7997efcd51d9173e24ed893b2a681d98d4d78; set by the owner (https://github.com/kailot-harris/NFL_analytics/issues/226#issuecomment-7166362267).
combined_score.flat_surface: The score surface is flat: every weighting tested sits inside the best one's 95% interval, and the NBA board's 0.7/0.1/0.1/0.1 was equally supported. No weighting predicts beyond Elo.
combined_score.refit: Never refit in the nightly build; re-evaluated each offseason by re-running the study in a pull request.

elo.expected_margin: (Elo - opponent Elo + home advantage x home sign) / points per margin point; pregame ratings

flags.significance_hidden_reason: No candidate flag reaches 80% simulated detection of a plausible effect at 3, 6 or 9 games (rolling-window study Table 11), so no flag carries a significance badge at any window. Raw values are shown; statistics are descriptive.

definitions.label: One-score record vs expected
definitions.value: win share in one-score games (ties half) minus 0.5
definitions.test: binomial z: wins in one-score games (|margin| <= 8, ties half) vs 0.5

definitions.label: Pythagorean vs actual
definitions.value: win share minus the Pythagorean share of the window's points (exponent 2.37)
definitions.test: binomial z: wins vs the Pythagorean expectation

definitions.label: Fumble-recovery rate
definitions.value: share of all fumbles in the team's games recovered by the team, minus 0.5

definitions.label: Opponent field-goal %
definitions.value: opponents' field-goal make rate minus the league rate this season
definitions.test: binomial z: opponents' field goals made vs the league rate

definitions.label: Turnover margin vs season level
definitions.value: window takeaways minus giveaways per game, minus the team's season-to-date level per game
definitions.test: Poisson z: window turnover margin vs the team's season level (variance 2 x league giveaways per game)

definitions.label: Blowout skew
definitions.value: share of games decided by 17+ points minus the league share this season
definitions.test: binomial z: blowouts vs the league share

definitions.label: Opponent strength
definitions.value: mean opponent pregame Elo minus the league mean pregame Elo of the game's season

definitions.label: Home share
definitions.value: share of the window's games as the listed home team

definitions.label: Rest / bye advantage
definitions.value: mean rest-day difference, team minus opponent (games after each team's first of its season)

definitions.label: Starting-QB change
definitions.value: number of games in the window (this season) whose starting QB differs from the team's previous game
definitions.test: none: context only until the forward log (#224) reports

definitions.label: Key players missing
definitions.value: share of key player-games in the window (this season) missed: listed Out or no snaps recorded

flags.detail_source: Fumble recovery, opponent field-goal %, turnover margin and the starting QB use this season's full play-by-play (CACHE_DNA_PBP); a window's carried games are excluded from them and counted in detail.
flags.key_players_missing: Key players: for each team and position, the player with the top snap share over the team's games this season (share per game = the larger of offense and defense snap %; kickers, punters and long snappers excluded). A key player-game is missed when the player is listed Out on that week's injury report (CACHE_INJURY_DATA, matched by name) or records no offensive or defensive snaps (CACHE_SNAP_COUNTS). Value = missed key player-games / key player-games in the window's games this season. Raw value only, no badge. Null with a reason when snap counts or injury reports do not cover the window.
flags.starting_qb_change: The starting QB is the passer with the most dropbacks (passer id, or the rusher id on scrambles; ties by id), as in the momentum measures study (#221). Context only until the QB-change forward log (#224) reports.

rank_history.rule: One row per team per window per completed week (every regular-season game of that week and earlier weeks has a score), appended once and never rewritten. History starts at launch; no backfill. rank_last_week is recomputed from games through the previous week.
